claims: Liberty Media Corporation holds approximately 30.09% of Live Nation Entertainment's common stock.
Liberty Media Corporation is the largest shareholder of Live Nation Entertainment.
Liberty Media is managed by Greg Maffei.
Liberty Media’s Greg Maffei is Chairman.
Michael Rapino is the CEO of Live Nation Entertainment.
Michael Rapino is the President of Live Nation Entertainment.
Institutional investors, including BlackRock, Inc., hold a combined stake of about 79.5% in Live Nation Entertainment.
Live Nation Entertainment was formed in 2009/2010 through the merger of Live Nation and Ticketmaster.
In April 2026, a U.S. federal jury found that Live Nation has been operating as a monopoly in the concert promotion and ticketing industry.
